csv_project_name: Phase II Engrg For Bull Valley Road Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The City of McHenry is requesting proposals for professional engineering services for the Bull Valley Road Bridge Phase II Engineering Project. The included Preliminary Scope of Services provides anticipated items which may be required to perform all necessary engineering work associated with this project. The Bull Valley Road Bridge Phase II Engineering is to be constructed in accordance with IDOT standards for STP Funding. The City of McHenry intends on reconstructing the Bull Valley Road Bridge over Boone Creek. The anticipated scope of work includes new abutments, approach slabs, railings to accommodate 2-12 drive lanes, 8 paved shoulders and a 10-ft wide multi-use path. The total width of the bridge is to be 54 feet. This will allow for future expansion of the roadway to a 3- lane section in the future. The project is generally located 1,000ft east of the Curran Road/Bull Valley Road intersection.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
